contea di ritrovamento: Greater London (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [IMP CAES NERVAE TR]AIANO AVG GER DAC [P M TR P COS V P P] ; R/ [SPQR OPTIMO PRINCIPI] // S C

A Roman copper alloy sestertius of Trajan (AD 98-117), probably mint of Rome issue AD 103-111, RIC II, p. 281, cf. no. 515 (Reece period 5). Obverse: Laureate head right, drapery on left shoulder. Obverse inscription: [IMP CAES NERVAE TR]AIANO AVG GER DAC [P M TR P COS V P P]. Reverse: Salus seated left, feeding snake at altar, left with patera. Reverse inscription: [SPQR OPTIMO PRINCIPI] // S C. Dimensions: diameter: 32.95mm; weight: 22.65g
